title: Filter / Search Cards by Text and Label
description: Filter and search cards by free text (title/description) and by label across the active board; non-matching cards are hidden until the filter is cleared.
spec:
1. Provide a text search input scoped to the active board
2. Provide label-based filtering
3. Verify only matching cards remain visible while a filter is active
4. Verify clearing the filter restores all cards
5. Verify filtering is case-insensitive for text
6. Verify columns still render (as empty) when all their cards are filtered out
